postSubject: Hello everyone, I am working on a recreation of Five Night's at Freddy's. It is called Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria. (name might be changed) How does it differ from the main game? Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria will have 3-4 modes in total (might be changed). The modes are: Training Mode, Debug Mode, Custom Mode and perhaps an extended campaign mode (maybe).Training Mode will allow to player to get used to FNAF 1's controls, they have features like infinite power (togglable), no animatronic movement, no time and more.Debug Mode (name might be changed) will allow the player to mess around with Five Nights at Freddy's mechanics. They will be able to control the animatronics movement, power levels, time, cameras and more.Custom Mode will most likely be gamemodes with some features that I see people requesting to be added to Five Nights at Freddy's. (Please give some ideas or features you would like to see. No promises that I will add your idea/feature) Also, Custom Mode might (maybe) allow the player to also play on different difficulties (similar to custom night) and allow them to tweak the game mechanics such as how long till the power drains and how long a night lasts etc.Extended Campaign mode might or might not be in the game, no confirmation yet. If it is in the game, it will most likely add some new features and make it somewhat harder than Night 6 and 20/20/20/20.There might be more modes added or removed along the way so please note that everything is subject to change. This is NOT a mod for Five Nights at Freddy's. It is a seperate game and bundles extra modes not included in Five Nights at Freddy's as stated above. Also, Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria supports Flash and might be released on it and Windows. No Mac, Linux etc ports. I will link a group dedicated to the game later and if you like the game feel free to join to get the latest updates, news and demos that might be released! Also, please provide some ideas for Custom Modes as stated above and if you have any specific mode you would like to see featured please post below. If you do not elaborate on your idea or mode I might not have enough details and might not be able to add it. Credits for everything goes to Scott Cawthon.Thanks for reading!Join the group!http://steamcommunity.com/groups/freddyfazbearspizzeriagame
